@'
import tomllib, shlex, subprocess, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); ref=Path((root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()); port=root/'executable'
patterns=['rust-reference/tests/cmd/*_all.toml','rust-reference/tests/cmd/*_windows.toml','rust-reference/tests/ptests/*.toml']
files=[]
for pat in patterns: files += sorted(root.glob(pat))
sel=[]
for f in files:
    data=tomllib.loads(f.read_text())
    args=data.get('args','')
    # applicable: requested surface, no forced color/icon always, no git/xattr/nix-only columns
    if any(x in args for x in ['--color always','--colour always','--icons always','--git','--extended','--blocksize','--header','--time-style relative']):
        continue
    if any(x in args for x in ['tests/itest','tests/test_dir']):
        if any(y in args for y in ['--long','-l','--tree','--all','--almost-all','--sort','--group-directories','--color never','--colour never','--icons never','--binary','--bytes','--classify','--no-user','--no-time','--no-filesize']) or f.parent.name=='cmd':
            sel.append((f,args))
print('selected',len(sel))
fail=[]
env=os.environ.copy(); env.update({'NO_COLOR':'1','CLICOLOR':'0'})
for f,args in sel[:80]:
    argv=shlex.split(args, posix=False)
    r=subprocess.run([str(ref)]+argv,cwd=root/'rust-reference',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,timeout=10)
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(port)]+argv,cwd=root/'rust-reference',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,timeout=10)
    if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
        fail.append((f,args,r,p))
        if len(fail)>=10: break
print('fail',len(fail))
for f,args,r,p in fail:
    print('CASE',f.relative_to(root),args)
    print('REF',r.returncode, r.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[:500], r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:300])
    print('PORT',p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[:500], p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:300])
'@ | python -
